title: MySQL: Add support for session track gitds & transaction info
description:
Add support for mysql session track: SESSION_TRACK_GTIDS, SESSION_TRACK_TRANSACTION_CHARACTERISTICS, SESSION_TRACK_TRANSACTION_STATE, see https://dev.mysql.com/doc/c-api/5.7/en/mysql-session-track-get-first.html
![image](/uploads/9e305d9f1a2fc163b2add5282ef4f168/image.png)
